text: Hallelu YAH! Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in His mighty expanse!
Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness!
Praise Him with the blast of the shofar; praise Him with the harp and lyre!
Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute!
Praise Him with cymbals sounding; praise Him with cymbals shouting!
Let everything that [has] breath praise YAH! Praise YAH!
